title: MRTK on quest
content:
MRTK on quest

create a 3D project on Unity Editor

switch platform in build settings

import XR plugin management from package manager

import MRTK example and MRTK foundation from MixedRealityFeatureTool(downloaded from Microsoft)

choose scene in MRTK example, change the profile into quest

build and run

check this and this videos for details
